quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Maya left her bicycle outside overnight. In the morning, the seat and handlebars were covered in tiny drops of water, even though no one had touched the bike.
options: It rained during the night.
Maya washed her bicycle before going to bed.
The bicycle was stored inside a garage.
Someone poured water on the bicycle on purpose.
quests.correctAnswer: It rained during the night.
quests.hint: Think about what could leave water on a bike that sat outside all night.
quests.explanation: The bike was left outside, and water appeared on it overnight without anyone touching it. Rain is the simplest explanation for water covering an untouched outdoor object.
logicChain: Bike left outside overnight -> water found on bike -> no one touched it -> rain fell overnight
